topic: Write an Observational Journal(写一篇自然观察日记)
genre: 观察日记 / 记叙说明(record how a living thing changes over time)
source: 外研社选必一 Unit 5 Developing ideas:Writing an observational journal(按时间记录一种植物/生物的生长变化,语言客观、可结合过去完成时表达先后)。
prompt_cn: 假设你在生物课上种了一株向日葵,并坚持记录它的生长。请用英语写一篇约90词的观察日记,内容包括:① 按时间(如第1周/第3周/第6周)记录向日葵的变化;② 至少一处用过去完成时说明'到某个时间点之前已经发生'的情况(如 By Week 6, it had already produced a flower);③ 结尾写下你的观察感受。注意语言客观、条理清楚。
prompt_en: Suppose you grew a sunflower in your biology class and kept a record of its growth. Write an observational journal (about 90 words) that: 1) records the changes week by week (e.g. Week 1 / Week 3 / Week 6); 2) uses the past perfect at least once to show what had already happened by a certain point (e.g. By Week 6, it had already produced a flower); 3) ends with how the observation made you feel.
points: 按时间分段记录变化(Week 1 … / Week 3 … / Week 6 …)
用过去完成时表达'到某时间点之前已完成'(By Week 6, it had already produced a flower)
语言客观、用词准确(stem, leaves, centimetres, flower)
结尾写观察感受、句句围绕'生长'这一中心
model_essay: Week 1: I planted three sunflower seeds in a pot of soft soil and placed it on the windowsill. The soil had been watered well before I added the seeds. Week 3: A thin green stem has pushed up from each seed, and the leaves are long and narrow. Week 6: The plants have grown to about thirty centimetres tall. By the time I measured them, one plant had already produced a small yellow flower. Watching nature reveal its secrets, day by day, has been truly wonderful.
model_translation: 第1周:我把三颗向日葵种子种进一盆松软的土里,放在窗台上。在放入种子之前,土已经浇透了水。第3周:每颗种子都钻出了一根细细的绿茎,叶子又长又窄。第6周:这些植株长到了大约三十厘米高。在我测量它们时,其中一株已经开出了一朵小小的黄花。日复一日地看着自然揭示它的奥秘,真是太奇妙了。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:按周记录变化 / 至少一处过去完成时 / 观察感受
按时间分段、条理清楚、句句围绕'生长'、行文连贯
用词准确客观、过去完成时与一般过去/现在完成运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 过去完成时 By the time …, it had already produced …
客观描述 The stem is … / The leaves are … / It has grown to … centimetres
感受结尾 Watching it change has been wonderful.
key_expressions: I planted three sunflower seeds in a pot of soft soil.
A thin green stem has pushed up from each seed.
By the time I measured them, one plant had already produced a flower.
Watching nature reveal its secrets has been truly wonderful.

high_sentences: The soil had been watered well before I added the seeds.
A thin green stem has pushed up from each seed.
By the time I measured them, one plant had already produced a small yellow flower.
Watching nature reveal its secrets, day by day, has been truly wonderful.

error_pairs.wrong: By Week 6, it produced already a flower.
error_pairs.correct: By Week 6, it had already produced a flower.
error_pairs.note: 到某过去时间点之前已完成,用过去完成时 had done。

error_pairs.wrong: The leaves is long and narrow.
error_pairs.correct: The leaves are long and narrow.
error_pairs.note: leaves 为复数主语,系动词用 are。

error_pairs.wrong: I planted the seeds before I had watered the soil.
error_pairs.correct: I had watered the soil before I planted the seeds.
error_pairs.note: 先发生的浇水动作用过去完成时,后发生的种子用一般过去时。

paragraph_template:
【自然观察日记结构】
Week 1 记录起点:I planted … and placed it on the windowsill.
Week 3 记录变化:A green stem has pushed up … The leaves are …
Week 6 用过去完成时:By the time I measured them, one plant had already produced a flower.
结尾感受:Watching nature reveal its secrets has been wonderful.
